testPolicy.text: Emory University is test optional for first-year students who would start in fall 2027. SAT/ACT scores are not required. If submitted, test scores are reviewed as a demonstration of academic preparation. Emory superscores both the SAT and the ACT; self-reported scores must be verified with official scores after enrolling.

cost.totalIncludes: Emory College, Oxford College and Goizueta: tuition 70,300 + fees 1,148 + housing 13,222 + food 9,184 + travel 1,100 + personal 1,620 + books 1,286 + Direct Loan fees 88 = 97,948. Not included: the required Emory student health insurance (about 5,592 a year) unless waived.

aidPromise.text: For first-degree domestic undergraduates, need-based loans have been replaced with institutional grants. Students from families earning up to $200,000, with typical assets, qualify for free tuition (Emory Advantage Plus; students must qualify for need-based aid, reviewed annually; covers up to eight semesters of tuition, fall and spring).

deadlines.early: November 1 (Early Decision I, decision by December 15); Early Decision II January 1 (decision by February 15)

facts.text: One application covers two entry points, Emory College (Atlanta) and Oxford College (a two-year campus in Covington, Georgia); students can apply to either or both, and even ED to one and Regular Decision to the other.
Early Decision admitted 1,049 of 4,728 applicants for fall 2025 (about 22%), against 3,869 of 37,561 overall (about 10%).
Families earning up to $200,000 with typical assets pay no tuition, and need-based loans are replaced with grants for domestic first-degree students.
The Emory University Scholar Programs (merit scholarships) have their own deadline, November 15, with decisions by March 1.
Georgia residents were 4,380 of the fall 2025 applicants and 447 of the admits; international applicants 9,207 and 576.
7,608 applicants were offered a waitlist place for fall 2025 and 274 were admitted from it.

notes: CDS 2025-26 (file name spelled 'common-date-set' on the university server) covers Emory College and Oxford College together. CDS G1 2026-27 figures match the Office of Financial Aid 2026-2027 worksheet (last updated 7/1/2026). Financial aid deadlines per plan: December 2 (ED I), January 6 (ED II), February 10 (RD). Start date of the test-optional policy not stated on the page; 'since' null. No official Class of 2030 figures checked (web search budget exhausted).
